status: post-selection sensitivity and shape comparison; exploratory, no new candidate selection

frozen_candidate.selected_from: HALOGAS HR only; fixed before opening WHISP intensities
frozen_candidate.selection: largest absolute residual in40x40arcsec x24.72km/s bins; x>0,|x|<=175arcsec,|z|>=60arcsec; known features masked

warp_control.method: positive-weight centroid within projected |z|<=60arcsec, Gaussian sigma40arcsec along major axis, clipped±30arcsec; exploratory nuisance diagnostic
warp_control.limitation: Not published 20-ring warp/spiral forward model; can absorb real emission asymmetry and does not remove line-of-sight mixing.

frozen_candidate.replication_rule: Same frozen signed bin and mirror, at40arcsec beam and same velocity/sky box; no region reselection or sign change. Compare amplitude uncertainty and sensitivity, not merely whether independent map looks similar.

spectral_control_note: Additional20/40km/s Gaussian smoothing on already resampled observed cubes is an LSF-sensitivity check, not exact native LSF deconvolution/matching.
